text:
Anika (CS): Heads-up: VertexHealth onboarding — during last two demos we saw intermittent demo lag. Renewal call in 3 days, want a rapid mitigation plan.
Rolf (SE): What are the metrics? sample request shape?
Anika (CS): p50 ~120ms, p95 spiking to ~1.4s for mixed 128-512 token prompts. Peak demo bursts ~18rps. No increase in 5xxs.
Priya (Infra): GPU utilization ok. Observed high KV cache churn and some large context payloads from their SDK (lots of few-shot examples). Cold-cache windows line up with the spikes.
Mika (Solutions): Two low-risk options: (1) model swap to microburst-x-int8 for demo-tagged traffic (smaller KV and faster step), or (2) keep model but enable kv_compress + prefix_cache for repeated system prompts. Both can be canaried.
Rolf (SE): I'll run a 150-sample eval on their prompt set for microburst-x-int8. Historically intent accuracy delta <0.8%. If OK we can do 20% canary.
Anika (CS): 20% sounds good — need a customer-facing note that it's targeted to demo traffic to improve responsiveness.
Priya (Infra): Sample route override (as text snippet) to apply: 
---
routes:
  - name: vertex-demo-fastpath
    match:
      - path: "/v1/chat/generate"
        headers:
          - name: "x-demo-mode"
            value: "true"
    policy:
      canary: 0.2
      prefer_pools: ["latency-rtx-pool"]
      fallback: "microburst-x-int8"
      toggles:
        prefix_cache: true
        kv_compress: moderate
      monitoring: [p50,p95,error_rate,quality_score]
---
(putting this here as plain text for ops)
Priya (Infra): I'll attach a dashboard and set alert: p95 > 700ms for 5m or quality_score drop >1.2 triggers rollback.
Rolf (SE): Quick eval update: 150 prompts -> critical intent accuracy 99.3% (baseline 99.5%), generative length -2 tokens on avg. Looks within tolerance. Uploading summary to enablement drive.
Mika (Solutions): If there's a slight quality dip we can flip to kv_compress only for demo traffic to preserve the exact model. Good fallback.
AlertBot: deploy queued -> job #deploy-2112 (canary=20%).
Anika (CS): Action items: Rolf -> upload eval summary (ETA 30m); Priya -> spin canary + dashboard (ETA 20m); Mika -> draft customer note for renewal lead (ETA 40m). I'll monitor and update renewal tracker.
Priya (Infra): Canary live. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/teams/vertexhealth/canary-2112. Initial canary p95 340ms, p50 110ms. No error increase.
Anika (CS): Great. I'll send the note to renewals as soon as Mika finishes draft. Keep thread open for 24h stability.
Rolf (SE): If anything odd shows in 2h I'll post flagged samples.
Mika (Solutions): Draft done and shared. Emphasize rollback plan and measured improvement in demo SLAs.
Anika (CS): Thanks all — marking as mitigation in tracker and will follow up post-24h.
